spans.s: khandhāvāra (= Pali id., MIndic for Skt. skandh˚), army-encampment: Mv 〔ii.485.14〕 khandhāvārehi (so read for Senart khandha˚; mss. khandhyā˚, khandya˚) kanyakubjaṃ nagaraṃ samantena veṭhiyāna sthitāḥ.

(khanya, mineral, cited once from late Skt. in khanyavāda-vid = BHS ˚vādin, below, see Schmidt, Nachträge; cf. Skt. khani, mine: khanya-vādin, mineralogist, Mvy 〔3753〕; khanya-dhātu-kriyā, the working of minerals, Mmk 〔346.9〕.)
khānta-samācāra, adj. m., of vile conduct; synonym of, or variant for, śaṅkhasvara-samācāra, q.v.: Mvy 〔9141〕 (not in Mironov).
